title: Call-to-action "Buy Now" leads to a broken page
risk: Visitors who click the main button reach an error page instead of the offer: paid traffic is wasted and the campaign cannot convert.
fix: Point "Buy Now" to a working page (the link returns HTTP 404). Re-test after deploying.

title: Buttons without an accessible name (1 element)

evidence.snippet:
Fix any of the following:
  Element does not have inner text that is visible to screen readers
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute
  Element does not have an implicit (wrapped) <label>
  Element does not have an explicit <label>
  Element's default semantics were not overridden with role="none" or role="presentation"

details.note: Automated checks only: they catch a subset of accessibility issues and do not cover all WCAG requirements.

risk: Screen readers announce just "button", so users cannot tell what it does (e.g. add to cart). Automated checks only: they catch a subset of accessibility issues and do not cover all WCAG requirements.
fix: Add visible text, or an aria-label describing the action, to every icon-only button.

title: Images without alternative text (1 element)

evidence.snippet:
Fix any of the following:
  Element does not have an alt attribute
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute
  Element's default semantics were not overridden with role="none" or role="presentation"

details.note: Automated checks only: they catch a subset of accessibility issues and do not cover all WCAG requirements.

risk: Screen reader users miss what the image communicates (product, offer, badge). Automated checks only: they catch a subset of accessibility issues and do not cover all WCAG requirements.
fix: Add a short alt text describing the image content, or alt="" if the image is purely decorative.

title: Button "Order today" may have no destination
risk: If the button really does nothing, visitors who want to buy cannot continue.
fix: Give the button a real destination (href to the product / checkout page) or verify its click handler works.

title: Text with insufficient contrast (1 element)
claim:
Delivery: courier shipping 19,99 lei. Returns within 14 days. 2-year warranty.

(contrast 1.43:1)

evidence.snippet:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 1.43 (foreground color: #c4c4c4, background color: #e9e9e9, font size: 9.8pt (13px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1

details.note: Automated checks only: they catch a subset of accessibility issues and do not cover all WCAG requirements.

risk: Low-vision visitors and anyone reading on a phone in sunlight may not be able to read this text, including prices or conditions. Automated checks only: they catch a subset of accessibility issues and do not cover all WCAG requirements.
fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until the contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text).

title: Page language is not declared (1 element)

evidence.snippet:
Fix any of the following:
  The <html> element does not have a lang attribute

details.note: Automated checks only: they catch a subset of accessibility issues and do not cover all WCAG requirements.

risk: Screen readers may read the page with the wrong pronunciation. Automated checks only: they catch a subset of accessibility issues and do not cover all WCAG requirements.
fix: Add lang="ro" or lang="en" to the <html> element.
